description: This file implements a serializer called TimeSpanCodec for serializing and deserializing the TimeSpan type in Orleans serialization system. It provides methods to write a TimeSpan value to a buffer and to read a TimeSpan value from a reader, using a fixed 64-bit wire format.

classes.name: TimeSpanCodec
classes.description: A serializer class responsible for serializing and deserializing TimeSpan objects.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a TimeSpan value into the buffer, writing its ticks as a fixed 64-bit value.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a TimeSpan value from the reader by reading a 64-bit integer representing ticks.
